title: Corneal endothelial cell loss after Baerveldt glaucoma drainage device implantation in the anterior chamber

license.statement: CC BY-NC-ND (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivs License, version not stated); not CC BY or CC0, so the record is private

indication: Glaucoma scheduled for Baerveldt tube surgery (Table 1: primary open-angle 13, secondary 30 - mainly uveitic, traumatic and post-vitrectomy eyes - and primary angle-closure 10 of 53 eyes); 45 of 53 eyes pseudophakic, none aphakic; about two thirds with previous trabeculectomy

groups.description: Baerveldt BG 101-350 glaucoma drainage device with the tube inserted into the anterior chamber (31 eyes 'free' in the AC, 22 transiridial through a peripheral iridectomy); single surgeon, Maastricht 2009-2011; prospective; 53 eyes of 35 patients

series.baseline_label: Preoperatively (Table 2 row label) = preoperative central ECD of the operated eye (Methods: measured preoperatively and at 3, 6, 12, 24 and 36 months)
series.notes: Table 2 column 'Mean ECD (cells/mm2) ± SD', rows Preoperatively and 3/6/12/24/36 months postop; central ECD by Konan Noncon ROBO Pachy SP-9000 specular microscopy, centre-dot method, mean of three images. Per-visit n not tabulated.

exclusions.what: Table 1 rows 'Tube free in the anterior chamber' and 'Transiridial placement of the tube' (preoperative ECD by tube placement)
exclusions.reason: Preoperative values only; follow-up for these subgroups is reported only as model-derived yearly loss rates, not as group means at follow-up times

exclusions.what: Peripheral quadrant ECD (quadrant closest to the tube and other quadrants)
exclusions.reason: Reported only as linear-mixed-model coefficients and yearly percentage rates, not as tabulated group means at follow-up times
Model estimates, not measured group means

exclusions.what: Phakic versus pseudophakic baseline ECD in the Results text

notes: Role: Baerveldt implantation is the study's standard procedure without an investigational agent; single control-role group.

53 eyes of 35 patients were included (both eyes of some patients). Patients needing additional intraocular surgery were followed until that surgery and excluded thereafter; three eyes (two tube repositionings, one decompensation after prolonged hypotony) were excluded from further analyses. The number of eyes behind each Table 2 mean is not reported; n is the 53 included eyes.
